AB-68
SRS AIRBAG — Troubleshooting

INSPECTION PROCEDURES

P Preparation
C Check

HINT: If airbag warning light does not light up, perform the following troubleshooting:

1 Check ECU-B fuse.

P Remove ECU-B fuse.
C Check continuity of ECU-B fuse.
OK Continuity.
Hint Replace fuse even if it appears to be OK during visual inspection.
· If fuse is OK, install it.

OK

NG Go to step 6 .

2 Check connection of center airbag sensor assembly connector.

OK

NG Repair.

3 Preparation.

LOCK

P (1) Disconnect battery negative (—) terminal cable, and wait at least 20 seconds.
(2) Remove steering wheel pad. (See page AB-15).

Caution
When storing steering wheel pad, keep upper surface of pad facing upward.
